project_type: Next.js 16 App Router with TypeScript, real-time emotion detection via face-api.js
test_framework: No test framework configured - validation is via build only
build_command: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm" && [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && cd /projects/sandbox/emociones-app && npm run build
test_command: No test command available - use build for validation
verification_instructions: Run npm run build successfully with no TypeScript errors
setup_instructions: Dependencies already installed. Build with: npm run build
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. Node.js v22 via nvm. Must prefix npm/node commands with: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm" && [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" &&. Next.js 16 has breaking changes: params/searchParams are promises. Check node_modules/next/dist/docs/ for API reference. AGENTS.md rule: read relevant Next.js docs before writing code.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing code style - dark theme, Tailwind CSS 4 utility classes, Spanish UI labels, lucide-react icons. Client components use 'use client' directive.
key_patterns: FaceDetector component uses requestAnimationFrame detection loop with face-api.js TinyFaceDetector. Saves captures every 5s to /api/captures. Uses refs for timing control (lastCaptureTime, lastAICallTime). Message generation via AI or static fallback. Dashboard fetches from /api/dashboard. All pages use dark gradient bg-gray-900 theme with emerald/indigo accent colors.
directory_structure: src/app/ - App Router pages and API routes. src/components/ - React components (FaceDetector.tsx). src/lib/ - Utilities (emotions.ts, ai-config.ts, db.ts, schema.ts). public/models/ - face-api.js model files.
